@legend.kids.time core.legend
    namespace=kids.time
    version=0.1.0
    imports=core
    imports=kids.common
    doc="Calendar and clock knowledge for primary school"

@kids.time.dayinfo core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="A day of the week with its place in the week."
    example="Monday is the first day of the week."

@kids.time.dayinfo.name core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Which day of the week?"

@kids.time.dayinfo.index core.key
    value=integer
    card=one
    ask="Which place in the week (1 = Monday)?"

@kids.time.dayinfo.kind core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Is it a school day or a weekend day?"

@kids.time.monthinfo core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="A month of the year with its length and season."
    example="March has 31 days and is a spring month."

@kids.time.monthinfo.name core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Which month?"

@kids.time.monthinfo.index core.key
    value=integer
    card=one
    ask="Which place in the year (1 = January)?"

@kids.time.monthinfo.days core.key
    value=integer
    card=one
    ask="How many days does the month have?"
    compute=true
@kids.time.monthinfo.season core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Which season is the month in (northern hemisphere)?"

@kids.time.monthinfo.remark core.key
    value=string
    card=one
    ask="Is there something special about the length?"

@kids.time.seasoninfo core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="A season with its place in the year."
    example="Spring comes after winter."

@kids.time.seasoninfo.name core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Which season?"

@kids.time.seasoninfo.index core.key
    value=integer
    card=one
    ask="Which place in the year (1 = spring)?"

@kids.time.length core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="How many smaller time spans fit in a bigger one."
    example="A week has 7 days."

@kids.time.length.whole core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Which time span (week, year, day, hour, minute, month)?"

@kids.time.length.part core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Which smaller time span is counted?"

@kids.time.length.times core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="How many of the bigger spans?"

@kids.time.length.count core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="How many are there?"
    compute=true

    extends=core.state
    doc="Which day of the week it is today (told in the dialog)."
    example="Today is Friday."

@kids.time.today.day core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Which day is it today?"

@kids.time.thismonth core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="Which month it is now (told in the dialog)."
    example="This month is May."

@kids.time.thismonth.month core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Which month is it now?"

    extends=core.state
    doc="What the clock shows now (told in the dialog)."
    example="It is 3 o'clock."

@kids.time.clockset.hour core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="Which hour does the clock show?"

    extends=core.state
    doc="Which day, month or season comes some steps after or before another one."

    card=one

    value=number
    card=one

    card=one

    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="From which day (or today)?"

@kids.time.gap.to core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Until which day?"

@kids.time.gap.count core.key
    value=integer
    card=one
    ask="How many days are there?"
    compute=true

    card=one
    ask="From which hour?"

@kids.time.hoursgap.to core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="Until which hour?"

    value=integer
    card=one
    ask="How many hours are there?"

    value=number
    card=one
    ask="How many hours later (negative for earlier)?"

@kids.time.clock.minutes core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="How many minutes later (negative for earlier)?"

@kids.time.clock.result core.key
    value=string
    card=one
    ask="What time is it then?"

    extends=core.state

    value=string
    card=one
    ask="What time is it now?"
    compute=true

files.operations.sop:
@op.kids.time.monthDays core.operation
    outputs=kids.time.monthinfo.days
    inputs=kids.time.monthinfo.name
    impl=monthDays
    semantics=query
    doc="The number of days of a month from the calendar knowledge, with a note for February."

@op.kids.time.shift core.operation
    outputs=kids.time.shift.result
    inputs=kids.time.shift.unit
    inputs=kids.time.shift.from
    inputs=kids.time.shift.by
    impl=shift
    semantics=query
    doc="The day, month or season some steps after or before another one, wrapping around; today and this month come from the dialog."

@op.kids.time.daysBetween core.operation
    outputs=kids.time.gap.count
    inputs=kids.time.gap.from
    inputs=kids.time.gap.to
    impl=daysBetween
    semantics=query
    doc="How many days until a day of the week comes, counting forward."

@op.kids.time.hoursBetween core.operation
    outputs=kids.time.hoursgap.count
    inputs=kids.time.hoursgap.from
    inputs=kids.time.hoursgap.to
    impl=hoursBetween
    semantics=compute
    doc="How many hours from one o'clock to another on a 12-hour clock."

@op.kids.time.length core.operation
    outputs=kids.time.length.count

    impl=lengthOf
    semantics=query
    doc="How many smaller spans fit in a bigger one: a fact from the knowledge base or a product along a chain of facts."

    impl=shift
    semantics=query
    doc="The season some steps after or before another one, wrapping around."
files.patterns.sop:
@pat.kids.time.today core.pattern
    match="[today|it|this_day] [is|was]? {d:lex.kids.time.days} [today|now]?"
    emit="@{_} kids.time.today day={d}"
    kind=statement
    priority=10
    example="Today is Friday."

@pat.kids.time.today.b core.pattern
    match="today it is {d:lex.kids.time.days}"
    emit="@{_} kids.time.today day={d}"
    kind=statement
    priority=10
    example="Today it is Monday."

@pat.kids.time.today.c core.pattern
    canonical="We are on Tuesday."
    match="we are on [a|an]? {d:lex.kids.time.days}"
    emit="@{_} kids.time.today day={d}"
    kind=statement
    priority=10
    example="We are on Tuesday."

@pat.kids.time.month.now core.pattern
    canonical="This month is May."
    match="[this_month|it|now|the_month] is {m:lex.kids.time.months}"
    emit="@{_} kids.time.thismonth month={m}"
    kind=statement
    priority=10
    example="This month is May."

@pat.kids.time.month.now.b core.pattern
    canonical="We are in March."
    match="we are in {m:lex.kids.time.months}"
    emit="@{_} kids.time.thismonth month={m}"
    kind=statement
    priority=10
    example="We are in March."

@pat.kids.time.clockset core.pattern
    match="[it|the_time] is {h:number} o'clock [now]?"
    emit="@{_} kids.time.clockset hour={h}"
    kind=statement
    priority=10
    example="It is 3 o'clock."

@pat.kids.time.clockset.b core.pattern
    canonical="The clock says 4 o'clock."
    match="the clock [shows|says|reads] {h:number} o'clock"
    emit="@{_} kids.time.clockset hour={h}"
    kind=statement
    priority=10
    example="The clock says 4 o'clock."

@pat.kids.time.q.day.n.after core.pattern
    match="what day [is|comes|will_it_be|was]? {k:number} [day|days] after {d:lex.kids.time.days}"
    emit="@{_} core.question type=kids.time.shift seek=result where.unit=day where.from={d} where.by={k}"
    kind=question
    priority=10
    example="What day is 3 days after Friday?"

@pat.kids.time.q.day.n.before core.pattern
    match="what day [is|comes|was|will_it_be]? {k:number} [day|days] before {d:lex.kids.time.days}"
    emit="@{_} core.question type=kids.time.shift seek=result where.unit=day where.from={d} where.by=-{k}"
    kind=question
    priority=10
    example="What day is 2 days before Monday?"

@pat.kids.time.q.day.tomorrow.if core.pattern
    match="what day is [it]? tomorrow [if|when] today is {d:lex.kids.time.days}"
    emit="@{_} core.question type=kids.time.shift seek=result where.unit=day where.from={d} where.by=1"
    kind=question
    priority=11
    example="What day is it tomorrow if today is Friday?"

@pat.kids.time.q.day.tomorrow.if.b core.pattern
    match="what day will it be tomorrow [if|when] today is {d:lex.kids.time.days}"
    emit="@{_} core.question type=kids.time.shift seek=result where.unit=day where.from={d} where.by=1"
    kind=question
    priority=11
    example="What day will it be tomorrow if today is Friday?"

@pat.kids.time.q.day.yesterday.if core.pattern
    match="what day [was|is]? [it]? yesterday [if|when] today is {d:lex.kids.time.days}"
    emit="@{_} core.question type=kids.time.shift seek=result where.unit=day where.from={d} where.by=-1"
    kind=question
    priority=11
    example="What day was yesterday if today is Friday?"

@pat.kids.time.q.day.if.tomorrow core.pattern
    match="[if|when] today is {d:lex.kids.time.days} what day [is|will_it_be] [it]? tomorrow"
